scope: Final-source normal-motion isolated Stage stories after fonts load, CPU1/CPU4, native/full, desktop DPR1/mobile DPR2. Matrix spans at least 28 seconds and the entire 104-column track; other stories span at least fourteen seconds and Globe completes its original twelve-second source orbit. Generated elapsed-time pointer/key/dock inputs are measured; physical input has separate checks. Complete private state/event samples and raw CDP traces are bound by hashes. Summaries retain all timing gaps and long tasks. Both final reports use v2 with an explicit final source-state sample after the measured loop. Public route/module transfer and final timing/stress gates remain open.

reports.scope: Isolated published native/full stages at desktop DPR1 and mobile DPR2, including 28-second complete Matrix tracks and fourteen-second torus/radial/globe input stories. Elapsed-time generated pointer/keyboard/dock inputs include drag, release and interrupted transitions; physical input is verified separately. Complete source state samples and actual CDP paint/layout/frame traces are bound to sources. Fonts are prepared before mounting. Readiness and first contentful paint are recorded; measurements do not declare final timing gates passed or include public route/module transfer.
